topics.title: What Is a Blockchain?
topics.summary: Understand a blockchain as a shared, append-only ledger that many strangers keep in sync, and why that is useful.

topics.title: Distributed Ledger Technology
topics.summary: Compare public permissionless chains with permissioned ledgers like Hyperledger, and know when a shared ledger is the right tool.

topics.title: Peer-to-Peer Networks and Nodes
topics.summary: See how nodes find each other, gossip transactions and blocks, and how full, light, and archive nodes differ.

topics.title: Cryptographic Hashing
topics.summary: Learn how hash functions like SHA-256 give fixed, unpredictable fingerprints of data, the primitive that links blocks together.

topics.title: Public and Private Keys
topics.summary: Understand asymmetric key pairs and addresses, and why whoever holds the private key controls the funds.

topics.title: Digital Signatures
topics.summary: See how ECDSA and EdDSA signatures prove ownership without revealing the key, and how chains stop signatures being replayed.

topics.title: Merkle Trees
topics.summary: Build a Merkle tree by hand and use it to prove a transaction is in a block without downloading the whole chain.

topics.title: Blocks, Transactions, and Chains
topics.summary: Trace how transactions are grouped into blocks and blocks are chained by hashes, and why that makes history hard to rewrite.

topics.title: Consensus Mechanisms Overview
topics.summary: Get a map of PoW, PoS, PoA, and BFT, the families of rules that let strangers agree on the next block.

topics.title: Mining vs Staking
topics.summary: Compare how miners spend energy and validators lock up capital to earn the right to add blocks, and the rewards for each.

topics.title: Block Structure and Mining
topics.summary: Look inside a real block header: previous hash, Merkle root, timestamp, and nonce, and see exactly what miners are hashing.

topics.title: The Bitcoin Whitepaper
topics.summary: Read Satoshi's nine pages with the background you now have, and separate what it actually claims from the mythology.

topics.title: Wallets: Hot vs Cold
topics.summary: Weigh browser, mobile, hardware, and multisig wallets on the security versus convenience spectrum, and protect a seed phrase.

topics.title: Your First Testnet Transaction
topics.summary: Set up a wallet, get free testnet coins from a faucet, send a transaction, and inspect it on a block explorer.

topics.title: The Mempool and Transaction Lifecycle
topics.summary: Follow a transaction from send to broadcast, mempool, fee competition, inclusion in a block, and final confirmation.

topics.title: UTXO vs Account Model
topics.summary: Contrast Bitcoin's unspent outputs with Ethereum's account balances, the design split behind how each chain tracks value.

topics.title: Ethereum and Smart Contracts Intro
topics.summary: Understand how Ethereum turned a ledger into a programmable platform where code called smart contracts runs on-chain.

topics.title: Proof of Work in Depth
topics.summary: Work through nonce search, difficulty adjustment, hash rate, and the economics that pushed mining onto ASICs.

topics.title: Proof of Stake and Variants
topics.summary: Learn validator selection, slashing, and finality in proof of stake, and how Ethereum's version works after the Merge.

topics.title: Other Consensus (PoA, PoH, BFT)
topics.summary: Explore authority-based, history-based, and Byzantine fault tolerant consensus and where each is used in practice.

topics.title: Bitcoin Script
topics.summary: Read and build simple Bitcoin Script locking conditions, and see why a deliberately limited language is a security feature.

topics.title: The EVM and Gas
topics.summary: Understand how the Ethereum Virtual Machine executes bytecode, how storage, memory, and calldata differ, and what makes gas expensive.

topics.title: Solidity Fundamentals
topics.summary: Write contracts using Solidity types, functions, modifiers, events, and inheritance.

topics.title: Remix IDE and Truffle
topics.summary: Deploy your first contract from the browser with Remix, and see why Truffle-era tooling gave way to newer frameworks.

topics.title: Hardhat and Foundry
topics.summary: Compile, test, and deploy contracts with a professional local toolchain, and compare Hardhat's JavaScript with Foundry's Solidity tests.

topics.title: Smart Contract Patterns
topics.summary: Apply the withdrawal pattern, pull over push, state machines, access control, and upgradeable proxies.

topics.title: Security: Reentrancy
topics.summary: Exploit and fix a reentrancy bug, and learn the checks-effects-interactions discipline that prevents it.

topics.title: The DAO Hack and Lessons
topics.summary: Study the 2016 reentrancy exploit that drained $60M, the Ethereum hard fork that followed, and the immutability debate it started.

topics.title: Security: Integer Overflow
topics.summary: See how overflow bugs caused real losses before Solidity 0.8, why SafeMath existed, and where unchecked math still bites.

topics.title: Common Smart Contract Vulnerabilities
topics.summary: Recognise access-control mistakes, tx.origin misuse, front-running, oracle manipulation, and denial-of-service bugs in contract code.

topics.title: ERC-20 Token Standard
topics.summary: Implement transfer, approve, and transferFrom, the interface every fungible token follows, and the allowance pitfalls.

topics.title: ERC-721 NFTs
topics.summary: Create non-fungible tokens with unique IDs and metadata, and learn what actually lives on-chain versus off-chain.

topics.title: ERC-1155 Multi-Tokens
topics.summary: Manage fungible and non-fungible tokens in one contract with batched transfers that save gas.

topics.title: IPFS and Decentralized Storage
topics.summary: Store files by content address with IPFS, pin them reliably, and host NFT metadata the way it is meant to be hosted.

topics.title: Web3.js and Ethers.js
topics.summary: Connect JavaScript apps to Ethereum using providers, signers, and contract objects to read state and send transactions.

topics.title: Building a Full-Stack dApp
topics.summary: Combine a contract, a web frontend, and wallet connection into a working decentralized app deployed to a testnet.

topics.title: Oracles (Chainlink)
topics.summary: Bring off-chain data on-chain with price feeds and verifiable randomness, and understand the trust problem oracles create.

topics.title: Stablecoins
topics.summary: Compare fiat-backed, crypto-backed, and algorithmic stablecoins, how each holds its peg, and why some have collapsed.

topics.title: Decentralized Exchanges (DEX)
topics.summary: See how Uniswap, Curve, and Balancer let people trade without a custodian, and why on-chain order books struggled.

topics.title: Automated Market Makers
topics.summary: Work through the x*y=k constant product formula, liquidity pools, slippage, and impermanent loss.

topics.title: DeFi Lending and Borrowing
topics.summary: Understand collateralized loans, health factors, liquidations, and interest rate curves on Aave and Compound.

topics.title: Yield Farming and Liquidity Mining
topics.summary: Learn how protocols reward liquidity providers with tokens, and trace where advertised yields actually come from.

topics.title: Layer 2 Scaling: Rollups
topics.summary: Understand how rollups execute many transactions off-chain and post a compressed commitment to Layer 1 to cut fees.

topics.title: MEV: Maximal Extractable Value
topics.summary: Understand front-running, sandwich attacks, and block builders, the hidden competition over transaction ordering.

topics.title: Flash Loans and Attacks
topics.summary: See how uncollateralized loans that repay within one transaction enable both arbitrage and multi-million-dollar exploits.

topics.title: Smart Contract Auditing
topics.summary: Audit a contract with manual review plus tools like Slither and fuzzers, and read a professional audit report critically.

topics.title: Formal Verification
topics.summary: Prove contract properties mathematically with tools like Certora, and weigh the cost against the assurance gained.

topics.title: Game Theory in Blockchain
topics.summary: Analyse incentives, nothing-at-stake, and slashing so that honest behavior is the rational choice for every participant.

topics.title: Tokenomics Design
topics.summary: Design supply schedules, vesting, sinks, and sources for a token that sustains value instead of collapsing after launch.

topics.title: DAOs and Governance Tokens
topics.summary: Understand on-chain proposals, voting, and treasuries, and the real-world problems of voter apathy and plutocracy.

topics.title: DAO Frameworks
topics.summary: Launch a DAO with Aragon, Snapshot, or Tally instead of writing governance contracts from scratch.

topics.title: Zero-Knowledge Proofs
topics.summary: Understand how to prove a statement is true without revealing why, and the circuits and commitments that make it work.

topics.title: ZK-SNARKs vs ZK-STARKs
topics.summary: Compare trusted setup versus transparent proofs, proof size, and prover time across the two main ZK families.

topics.title: Optimistic vs ZK Rollups
topics.summary: Contrast fraud proofs with validity proofs and their effects on security, withdrawal delay, and cost.

topics.title: Sidechains and Bridges
topics.summary: See how sidechains and token bridges like Polygon and Ronin work, and why bridges have been the most hacked part of crypto.

topics.title: Cross-Chain Communication
topics.summary: Learn the mechanics of moving messages and value between chains: lock and mint, relayers, and light-client verification.

topics.title: Cross-Chain Standards
topics.summary: Compare CCIP, IBC, LayerZero, and Wormhole as competing interoperability standards and judge their trust assumptions.

topics.title: Modular Blockchains
topics.summary: Understand splitting execution, settlement, consensus, and data availability into separate layers, as Celestia does.

topics.title: Restaking and EigenLayer
topics.summary: See how staked ETH is reused to secure other services through EigenLayer, and the systemic risks that creates.

topics.title: Account Abstraction (ERC-4337)
topics.summary: Build smart-contract wallets with sponsored gas, batched actions, and social recovery for a far better user experience.

topics.title: Privacy Coins: Monero, Zcash
topics.summary: Understand ring signatures, stealth addresses, and shielded ZK transactions, the privacy techniques behind Monero and Zcash.

topics.title: Blockchain Privacy and Compliance
topics.summary: Examine Tornado Cash, sanctions, and privacy pools, the unresolved tension between financial privacy and regulation.

topics.title: Central Bank Digital Currencies
topics.summary: Compare CBDCs with cryptocurrencies and stablecoins, their design choices, and the political questions they raise.

topics.title: Real-World Asset Tokenization
topics.summary: See how bonds, real estate, and commodities are brought on-chain, and the legal and custody problems that remain.

topics.title: Career Paths in Web3
topics.summary: Map roles in smart contract development, security, protocol research, and infrastructure, and plan the skills each one needs.
